preregistration.reason: Model, operating gates, effective cluster count, precision/power target, budget and final native adapter are not locked.

contribution_hierarchy.primary: Measure behavioral non-composition of common-ancestor updates that independently satisfy a frozen branch-improvement qualification rule.
contribution_hierarchy.secondary: Evaluate a fixed-candidate integration policy with identical evidence access and complete cost accounting.
contribution_hierarchy.tertiary: Separate continued-evolution/meta-policy experiment; histories diverge; not implemented or tested.
not_claimed: causal mechanism from a graph or narrative alone

event_schema.authorship_independence: Separate information contexts and access records; no access to the other branch contents, diffs, validation results or negative lessons until both are frozen. Shared model/platform does not imply independent outcomes.
event_schema.eligibility: Q improvement for A and B against the same ancestor; frozen nonregression/resource gate; complete version and replay provenance. Hand-authored candidates lack empirical independent-improvement status until this is observed.
event_schema.pair_selection: Schedule candidate pairs and task allocations without looking at AB/BA scoring failures. A targeted challenge set is separately labeled.
event_schema.composition_rule: Freeze the deterministic update-application and assembly rule before trials. Record replace versus add, overlapping diffs, duplicate names/triggers and resource conflicts; never silently overwrite A with B while calling both preserved. Check installed/available content hashes. Nonactivation remains in availability outcomes but does not prove execution-time semantic interference.
event_schema.all_attempt_records: Retain failed generation, invalid candidates, qualification failures, zero eligible pairs, exclusions and incomplete events.

D.name: authoring and policy development
D.boundary: D may be adaptively reused with its attempt ledger; it is not final Q/C/S evidence.

Q.name: individual improvement qualification
Q.access: Auditor evaluates frozen branches; authors do not tune on the qualification feedback.
Q.inputs: Source/task groups disjoint from final scoring and authoring. If qualification feedback is reused for editing, the panel becomes development and a fresh reserved Q is required.
Q.repeat_policy: Predeclare attempt/requalification stopping and multiplicity or obtain new independent observations.

C.name: cohort selection audit
C.access: Auditor-only; not returned to integration policy or skill authors.
C.inputs: Independent executions of ancestor and isolated branches on planned scoring task identities for task-conditioned H/G, or a separately declared family/capability sampling rule.
C.boundary: Do not identify H using the same outcome later counted as fresh baseline performance. Do not choose a harmful AB cohort to estimate natural incidence.

S.name: fresh final scoring
S.access: Independent final auditor; policy output frozen before feedback.
S.inputs: Fresh executions, distinct from Q/C/D. Same-task replay retains input/contract hash; variant transfer requires a different family estimand.
S.boundary: Seeds/repetitions are execution replicates, not independent tasks or leakage protection.

treatments.primary_population: Every task assigned to the availability arm, including tasks where routing activates neither branch.
treatments.canonical_joint_order: AB; editable proposal, must be frozen before S and interpreted within native router semantics.
treatments.secondary_order: BA, not selected post hoc to maximize or minimize effect.
treatments.diagnostic_mode: Forced injection of all registered skill content; separate from availability.
treatments.reset: Fresh workspace/environment from the same snapshot per task/arm/repetition; no prior arm outputs, candidate edits, hidden solution scripts or cache-derived answer reuse.
treatments.resource_match: Same final contract, mounted assets and executable resources, tool rights, model snapshot, context/output caps, timeout and retry attribution in instruction-only comparisons.
treatments.package_effect: A separate native-package comparison may allow resources to differ and must say so.

primary.dataset: SkillsBench v1.1 main only; do not pool heterogeneous benchmark outcomes.
primary.outcome: Y=externally verified native task completion plus all public mandatory preservation checks; agent-caused invalid/timeout counts as zero.
primary.weighting: Explicit target weights on independently generated histories and original source-family groups, then fixed within-group task weights; final weights unset until inventory audit.
primary.interpretation: Expected additional completion gain/loss of canonical joint deployment relative to a fair mixture of isolated branches, conditional on the qualification protocol.
primary.not_interpreted_as: Loss against an oracle-best branch, source-population universal frequency, or a causal interface diagnosis.

secondary.warning: Negative tau alone is not a strict failure; ceiling saturation can give negative tau with the joint arm best.

secondary.classification: confirmed only under a frozen uncertainty rule; unresolved when precision is insufficient; separate AB/BA.

secondary.warning: Calculated or scripted manipulation check; not an empirical natural-event estimate.

secondary.definition: An ancestor-failing, isolated-branch-successful cohort loses success in joint deployment; not labeled strict1110.

secondary.meaning: Absolute fresh selected-output failure rate in the independently selected H cohort.
Additional fresh failure relative to the fresh ancestor in H; can be negative.
Fresh success among independently selected branch-acquired tasks; report the same comparator reference and cohort rule.

estimands.empty_denominators: NA/null plus denominator=0 and absence reason; unaudited, missing, and empty are distinct.
estimands.natural_frequency: Report all-attempt event counts, Q-eligible counts, assigned event-task counts, determinate witness counts, unresolved counts, and unresolved-aware bounds. Do not silently remove ambiguous cases.
estimands.selection_bias: Qualification conditions the population. C selection produces regression-to-mean even with fresh S. Same-task C/S does not establish unseen-family retention.

formal_statements.status: author educational mathematical model, not empirical skill independence or a novelty claim
formal_statements.prior_overlap: SkillSmith v2 already treats typed signatures, atomic migration and scoped failure persistence. Our model illustrates semantic preconditions and the measurement distinction.
assumptions: fixed domain of three authored valid inputs

types.Phi: Correct normalized amount, and matching record_id iff require_id is true.

functions.R0: If text contains ',' return error; otherwise parse integer and multiply by unit factor, emit Won with original record_id.
functions.RA: Remove ',' on this restricted valid domain, parse integer, emit Native with unchanged unit and record_id.
functions.P0: Accept Won or Native; normalize native units; emit correct amount only, omit record_id.
functions.PB: Accept Won only; emit amount_won and record_id; reject Native.
functions.adapter_T: Accept Native, convert by its true unit factor, emit Won with unchanged record_id.

formal_statements.counterexample: A and B each improve the mathematical uniform mean by 1/3 over S0, while AB loses the retained t0. This does not supply empirical authorship isolation, sampling or Q/S evidence.

preservation.assumption_two: For every x∈D and every m∈Pre(PB,x), Φ(x,PB(m)) holds.
preservation.proof_sketch: Substitute m=RA(x) from assumption one into assumption two. For the toy adapter, unit normalization and ID preservation make T(RA(x)) an admitted Won artifact, so all three cases satisfy Φ.
preservation.limitations: A static number type does not capture units, identity, evidence or side effects. Incompatible typed outputs may be safely rejected; this is a completion failure/deferral, not silent wrong arithmetic. A tag-erasing adapter can silently break semantic refinement. No stochastic LLM guarantee follows.
preservation.semantic_precondition: Pre(PB,x) consists of Won records whose amount equals the correct unit-normalized input x and whose record_id equals x.record_id when required. This is a semantic refinement, not all records tagged Won. PB copies the correct fields; syntax validation alone does not establish this assumption.

benchmarks.adapter_plan: Newly author S0/A/B instruction candidates; keep native task contract and identical permitted resources. Do not redistribute bundled third-party skills before asset review. Native with/no-skill support does not create qualified common-ancestor events.

benchmarks.split_rule: Hash original cited-document/normalized-claim connected components before using labels; exclude any train component touching official dev. New test is a public original-train adaptation.
benchmarks.selector: Exactly one cited document per claim by deterministic hash of IDs, without consulting gold labels. Absence of annotation yields annotation-based insufficient; not an independent factual certification.

role_assignment_proposal.D: A new component split within adapted train for authoring and policy development.
role_assignment_proposal.Q: Adapted dev reserved for one-shot branch qualification; not policy tuning.
role_assignment_proposal.C: Auditor-only fresh cohort runs on assigned adapted-test task hashes.
role_assignment_proposal.S: Separate executions on those assigned test hashes; task-conditioned endpoint.

benchmarks.primary_outcome: Schema-valid label_correct over all assigned cases; an invalid, missing, or agent-caused timeout response contributes zero. Rationale coverage and precision are separate diagnostics.
benchmarks.rationale_boundary: All complete annotated alternatives and supersets accepted; all-sentence outputs can meet coverage but may have low precision. This is not native SciFact retrieval/rationale F1.
benchmarks.mutations_scope: train-only constructed evaluator-stress file; not original labels, authenticated error history or SkillMerge event count.

status.local_preparation: 531 cases prepared and semantic replay recorded

licenses.mirror_card_conflict: Record-level source matters; HF mirror has older CC-BY-NC-2.0 declaration.

benchmarks.plan: Create disjoint repository/module source groups before candidate work; use fresh base-commit environment per arm, evaluator-only gold/test patches and native FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS completion. Remove future-commit and cached-output leakage according to a reviewed adapter. Core dataset does not natively provide SKILL composition or histories.

controls.name: AB_vs_BA
controls.requirement: Both orders preallocated; canonical primary order fixed before scoring; no favorable-order selection.

controls.name: instruction_only
controls.requirement: All arms share executable resources, source data and tool permissions; package-level effect separately reported.

controls.name: token_length_irrelevant
controls.requirement: Actual tokenizer matched input blocks within a frozen tolerance; irrelevance audited on development without final answer access.

controls.name: token_length_padding
controls.requirement: Padding structure and placement fixed; not assumed behaviorally neutral.

controls.name: disjoint_scope
controls.purpose: General co-residence versus shared artifact scope
controls.requirement: Task relevance and positive exposure checked; easy irrelevant pairs cannot be treated as equivalent stress.

controls.name: semantic_adapter
controls.requirement: Matched unrelated text/tokens/resources; explicit unit/key/provenance boundary correction; no changed final task.

controls.name: native_availability_vs_forced
controls.requirement: Nonactivation remains in availability denominator; activation observations are posttreatment diagnostics.

controls.name: grader_and_dataset_challenge
controls.requirement: Independent valid alternatives, corrupt answers, source mismatches, semantic/split replay; old artifacts remain preserved.

integration_secondary.candidate_pool: Same Q-eligible immutable candidates; generation fixed and separately costed.
integration_secondary.evidence_access: D evidence only; no C/S/auditor-only labels or expected artifacts.
integration_secondary.cache: Key by state, candidate, task, contract, evaluator and environment; history reuse is context evidence, not a fresh behavioral success.
integration_secondary.costs: Record real model tokens including cache tokens, authoring/scheduling/repair calls, tool CPU/wall time, retries and failures. One primary resource cap and cost sensitivity locked before S; synthetic fixture units are not money or energy.
integration_secondary.qualification_and_audit: Separately report full research overhead; independent final audit does not become policy feedback.
integration_secondary.policy_endpoint: Output completion at one fixed budget versus strongest D-selected equal-budget baseline, together with F_H/R_excess/G retention and no-gain/deferral.

analysis.primary_unit: Paired event-task contrast nested within original source groups and update histories.
analysis.dependence: Many tasks share one candidate history; many histories share one task family. Execution repeats, seed matches, orders and variants are not independent population samples.
analysis.uncertainty: Choose a justified crossed cluster/bootstrap model or deliberately independent blocks after inspecting cluster counts. Do not automatically apply a one-axis bootstrap to crossed data.
analysis.family_weighting: Lock whether equal-family/equal-history weighting or a task-frequency target is intended; report secondary task-weighted results rather than switching silently.
analysis.multiplicity: One primary theta; predeclare witness/order/contract-intervention contrasts and a Holm family where suitable. No corrected test has been run.
analysis.missingness: Preserve all raw records. Agent-caused invalid/timeout=completion failure. External outages/censoring remain explicit under frozen retry rules; include conservative bounds when unresolved, never complete-case success as primary.
analysis.power: Use pilot independent-cluster variance/covariance and qualification yield to simulate budget/precision before final sample-size lock; target effect, CI width and alpha currently null.
analysis.natural_vs_stress: Separate natural proposal-stream frequency from intentionally incompatible crafted tasks/skills and from deterministic software fixtures.
analysis.secondary_evolution: Policy-specific histories diverge; analyze generation+integration+execution as history-level treatment, not fixed-candidate paired effects.

falsification: Q-eligible natural events show no material negative theta or very rare strict witnesses within prespecified precision.
Matched length/order/resource or corrected-grader controls account for apparent collapse.
An interface intervention does not improve the planned contract check under matched controls, or a different intervention is sufficient.
Budgeted policy fails the practical advantage against a strong fixed baseline, loses newly acquired capabilities, or wins only by deferring everything.
Continued adaptive policy offers no measurable value beyond a frozen mechanism at full cost.
